content.text: In many regions, conventional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal are either unavailable or heavily restricted. This poses a significant challenge for digital creators looking to monetize their products. Fortunately, with the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-4|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]-guide-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-4|The Full]], you can establish a fully operational digital store that accepts crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-2|payments]] without relying on these platforms. This guide will walk you through using Supabase as your order database, leveraging COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02 to ensure a seamless setup and operation.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This infrastructure operates independently of conventional payment platforms, which often fail due to regulatory restrictions or account limitations. By utilizing open-source tools like Supabase and NOWPayments, you create a resilient digital store that guarantees control and ownership. This setup ensures that you are not just a user on someone else's platform but the architect of your commerce infrastructure, providing sovereignty over your products and payments. This is particularly crucial in regions facing economic instability, where digital creators need reliable and accessible solutions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating the deployment process, ensure you have the necessary components. You will need a GitHub account for hosting your site on GitHub Pages or a Cloudflare account for Cloudflare Pages. Set up a Supabase account for your order database, and register with NOWPayments to handle crypto payments. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which will guide you through the setup process. Lastly, prepare your digital products for upload, ensuring they are ready for delivery through your chosen storage solution, whether it be Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying the backend infrastructure. If you choose Stack 01, use GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script to set up your site and connect to NOWPayments for payment processing. For Stack 02, deploy Cloudflare Pages and Workers, integrating Supabase for order management. After setting up, configure the delivery method for your digital products, ensuring files are accessible once payment is confirmed. Use automatic webhooks from NOWPayments to trigger delivery and order updates in your Supabase database. This streamlined process ensures a seamless experience for your customers.
Take control of your digital commerce infrastructure today.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up and thoroughly tested, it’s time to go live. Ensure all configurations are correct and data ownership is firmly established. Promote your digital store, directing traffic to your GitHub or Cloudflare Pages site. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration will automatically process the payment and trigger file delivery. Monitor the transaction and order updates in your Supabase database, ensuring everything operates smoothly. This first transaction is pivotal; it validates your infrastructure and sets the stage for future sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing transactions, focus on scaling your infrastructure. Utilize insights from your Supabase database to analyze customer behavior and optimize your product offerings. Consider adding more products or exploring new markets. If you started with Stack 01, assess the benefits of transitioning to Stack 02 for enhanced capabilities. With Cloudflare Pages and Workers, you can manage increased traffic and provide better performance. Continuously refine your marketing strategies to reach a broader audience and increase your sales volume.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by setting up a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting. Use Supabase as your order database, and integrate NOWPayments for processing transactions. This setup allows you to circumvent conventional payment platforms and maintain complete ownership of your store.
No more reliance on platforms that restrict your access.

If you're looking for a more robust solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers enhanced features and faster deployment. This stack allows you to efficiently harness Cloudflare Pages and Workers alongside Supabase and NOWPayments for optimal performance. Explore further at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Start by setting up a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting. Use Supabase as your order database and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows complete control over your store without relying on conventional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for a quick setup, while Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare Pages and Workers for enhanced performance and scalability. Stack 02 also includes Supabase for advanced order management and is deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are viable options for hosting your digital product store. They allow you to deploy your site quickly while integrating with tools like Supabase and NOWPayments to handle orders and payments.
What are the benefits of using Supabase for order management?

Supabase provides a powerful backend for managing orders, offering real-time updates and a user-friendly interface. It ensures that you have full control over your order data and can scale your operations seamlessly.
How can I ensure my digital store is secure?

To secure your digital store, implement HTTPS through your hosting provider, use secure payment gateways like NOWPayments, and regularly update your software components to protect against vulnerabilities.
